rationale: Additive linear response in target units. Baseline = support mean. Features added once each in order of strength (BMI, log-triglycerides s5, blood pressure, HDL s3, sex, glucose s6, ...); each slope is read as a two-group contrast (top 40% minus bottom 40%) of the residual left by previous features, divided by the feature contrast, then shrunk by 0.8; slopes under 3 units per SD are dropped. No least squares, no refitting passes.
